t: How Wealthy Households Use a “Buy, Borrow, Die” Strategy to Avoid Taxes on Their Growing Fortunes
s: April 29, 2024 - Wealthy family buys stocks, bonds, real estate, art, or other high-value assets. It strategically holds on to these assets and allows them to grow in value. The family won’t owe income tax on the growth in the assets’ value unless it sells them and makes a profit. Wealthy family borrows against its assets’ growing value and uses the newly available cash to live off or invest in other assets, like rental properties.
